\part{Scientific rationale}

\section{The scientific question}

The method answers one narrow question: at each admitted parent-pixel anchor, what is
the amplitude of one exact, already-declared template in one exact ordinary-MAP
parent? The answer is a map of template amplitude. The method does not decide
whether a source exists, choose a candidate, infer a posterior sky, or attach
catalog meaning to a peak.

Base v0.1 places one anchor at every exact parent ordinary-MAP pixel center,
preserving WCS, frame, grid, shape, indexing, ordering, and the pixel-center
convention. It does not interpolate or optimize an anchor. Another output
lattice is a separately named successor.

The template is not merely a shape used for smoothing. It is the expected
parent-map response per unit amplitude, including its scale, phase, anchor,
sampling, support, and calibration/beam lineage. That scaling defines what one
unit of the answer means. A template whose unit amplitude denotes point-source
flux can support that interpretation only when the exact CAL/BEAM and parent
lineages authorize it; another template gives a shape amplitude instead.

\section{Why the estimator is normalized}

The parent is contracted with the template through a frozen complete
coordinate-basis weighting object. Every required pixel or quadrature measure
is already inside that bilinear object; there is no second unexplained measure.
The same weighting is applied to the template itself, producing the
normalization. Dividing these two contractions makes an exact matching
template return its supplied amplitude on complete valid support. This unit
response is the central scientific identity.

Weighting and uncertainty are deliberately not conflated. If the weighting is
the exact authorized inverse covariance on the same population, support,
conditioning state, and estimable subspace, the estimator has the familiar
inverse-covariance GLS minimum-variance property only after a local operator
domain is declared before construction, covariance is restricted to that
domain, and it is inverted on an exact identifiable
estimable subspace. Under a weaker spectral or
reliability weight, it can remain matching-template normalized without being
minimum variance. In that case the denominator is normalization, not a
variance estimate.

\section{Why state is explicit and frozen}

The transformation must mean the same thing for the signal parent and every
NOI realization member admitted by the frozen pre-Apply compatibility
predicate. Learn derives candidates and diagnostics
from one declared population; Resolve selects the authorized route and freezes
its identity; Apply uses it unchanged. Externally declared state enters
Resolve. Learning again from each NOI member would change the ensemble method
and its uncertainty meaning. New NOI-informed knowledge creates a successor
generation rather than rewriting an existing one.

Observation and coadd parents also remain scientifically separate. Filtering
an observation and filtering a coadd are two local applications with different
parent identities and state generations. This contract neither asserts that
filtering commutes with coaddition nor owns a coaddition operation.

\section{Why edges are unavailable rather than repaired}

The local domain used to construct covariance, weighting, and normalization is
declared before the final row exists. Each amplitude then depends on complete
application support: every parent payload row with a nonzero coefficient in
that row. A coordinate can influence construction while having a final exact
zero coefficient; its payload need not be dereferenced, but its causal lineage
is retained. Template-query,
state-learning, response-query, and storage supports are recorded separately.
If one dependency is absent or invalid, the estimator defined here does not
exist at that location. Filling, extending, renormalizing, fitting a background,
or learning an edge taper would define another method. Numerical fill is
harmless only after erosion proves that no admitted output depends on it.

\section{Response and uncertainty are full scientific objects}

Unit self-response does not make the response a single symmetric beam or make
neighboring sources disappear. For a general linear sky, the expectation is
the full response-weighted sum of template amplitudes plus the linear action on
any residual mean, offset, gradient, or other deterministic background. The
off-diagonal response can be anisotropic, asymmetric, nonstationary,
position-dependent, or nonlocal. Reducing it to a kernel, radial profile, or
solid angle is allowed only after the required invariances, measure, and valid
domain are established. Fixed-state response is not the response of a
data-dependent Learn--Resolve procedure. That full-procedure quantity requires
an authorized rerun or finite difference and is otherwise unavailable.

Likewise, a conditional covariance product exists only when matching parent
law authority exists. Actual finite-precision production is represented by a
fixed-state map $F_g$, not presumed to be linear. A field carries its
operational realized response and U1 covariance; matrix propagation is used
only after fixed-state linearity is established. Exact-reference quantities
remain comparators. U2 calibration/template uncertainty, learned-state,
numerical discrepancy,
representation, NOI sampling, and template-mismatch contributions have
different populations and conditioning. The normative uncertainty budget
keeps them separate rather than producing an unsupported scalar total.

\section{Product and governance rationale}

The primary science product is one atomic signal bundle: amplitude map plus
the facts required to know exactly what it means. Covariance, empirical NOI,
response, and state/lineage products are independently atomic companions.
Their failure is explicit. Optional failure does not silently alter the signal
estimand, while failure of a required signal member prevents publication of a
complete signal bundle.

The product also preserves a first-class FLT to FRUIT handoff. Its finite v0.1
query vocabulary makes the named FLT-side scientific facts available or
exactly reconstructable without exposing undocumented implementation state. A
future query outside that vocabulary requires a successor FLT envelope rather
than retroactive overpromising. The handoff intentionally says nothing about
FRUIT's future model, iteration, selection, response, uncertainty, or
interpretation.

Finally, the contract separates claim layers that are often confused:
scientific authority defines the method; conformity concerns a specific
implementation; representation fidelity concerns an exact encoding; SCI-VAL
evaluates named-use profiles; observational validation and achieved performance
are evidence classes; readiness is a governance decision; and production is
an operational state. Evidence in one layer does not promote another.

\part{Owner-disposition guide}

\section{What remains for the scientific owner}

This draft separates scientific-owner decisions, engineering
preregistration/representation selections, and successor-authorship triggers.
The owner disposes only the remaining scientific meanings. Engineering selects
exact representations and one numerical profile after those meanings are
fixed. The decision ledger records the exact routing.

\begin{longtable}{p{0.20\linewidth}p{0.31\linewidth}p{0.39\linewidth}}
\toprule
Family & Authority and decision & Route unavailable before disposition \\
\midrule
\endhead
\AO{001} & Scientific owner: concrete weighting authority for observation and
coadd separately. B/D remain successor-authorship triggers until concrete
$W_p$ objects exist. & A weighting realization, any optimality label, and any
variance meaning derived from the weight. \\
\AO{002} & Engineering: preregister one exact-operator numerical profile.
Scientific owner acts only to commission a concrete distinct successor
operator. & Any numerical-conformance statement. \\
\AO{003} & Scientific owner: named covariance role and complete, projected, or
unavailable scope. Engineering: resident or lineage representation afterward.
& Covariance publication, standardization, or covariance-dependent use. \\
\AO{004} & Scientific owner: finite required state-query vocabulary.
Engineering: full, compact-exact, or lineage representation. & State
audit/reanalysis and handoff queries requiring reconstructable state. \\
\AO{005} & Scientific owner: response type, domain, query vocabulary, validity,
and consumer scope.
Engineering: full, structured, or lineage representation. & Response-dependent
use and FLT-to-FRUIT response queries. \\
\AO{006} & Scientific semantics are decided: seven roles and dependency graph.
Engineering chooses separate, grouped, or vector layout. & Registered SCI-VAL
named-use evaluation still awaits its policies and facts. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

No option choice alone authorizes a numerical route. After owner disposition,
an implementation still needs separate conformity evidence; profiles need
separate SCI-VAL evaluation; observational validation, measured performance,
readiness, and production remain
separate decisions.
